dedupe_keys.name: statewide probabilistic flood hazard maps for idaho usa ensemble mean water depth and flood probability datasets derived from the torrent hydraulic model

description: Idaho State University researchers publish statewide flood-depth and inundation-probability products. Zenodo provides a ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The Torrent hydraulic model was run for forty-eight scenario combinations: four return periods, four rainfall durations and three precipitation uncertainty conditions. Each scenario uses one hundred model realisations and supplies an ensemble mean depth and cell-level inundation probability raster. These maps can drive asset exposure and flood-risk simulations in Idaho. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this statewide scenario set. Coverage is Idaho and the rainfall or hydraulic assumptions in the published experiment, not measured future flood extent. A limitation is that probability maps are conditional on scenario and model ensemble; they should not be read as unconditional annual occurrence probabilities. The ZIP was not downloaded, so raster projection, resolution and completeness remain unchecked. No model run or flood depth was independently verified.
